Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Cardiac EF <=35% by radionuclide ventriculography, left ventriculography or quantitive echocardiographic measurement or an echocardiographic Wall Motion Index of <=1.2, within three months of enrollment.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has ischemic cardiomyopathy but no explicit EF or Wall Motion Index values provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The patient's clinical cardiac state at enrollment should be similar to their state at the time of the qualifying echocardiogram.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No data on timing of qualifying echocardiogram relative to enrollment.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The qualifying left ventricular function measurement must be obtained at least three months after an MI, coronary bypass grafting, PTCA, and at least one month after pacemaker insertion.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient had CABG and PTCA but no data on timing of LV function measurement post-procedures.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient must be taking ACE inhibitors. If intolerant of ACE inhibitor, patient must be on angiotensin II receptor blockers or hydralazine and nitrates.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information on antihypertensive medication use.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient is able to follow an outpatient protocol (requiring monthly blood tests and clinic visits every four months for the duration of the study) and is available by telephone.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of inability to follow protocol; patient is 58 years old with no reported functional limitations.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient understands the purpose and requirements of the study, can make him/herself understood, and has provided informed consent.
Patients with recent stroke or TIA within twelve (12) months will be eligible to be included in the recent stroke (RS) subgroup.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No history of stroke or TIA documented.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Chronic CHF patients (NYHA I * IV) admitted to the hospital can be randomized prior to discharge if the patient is stable, taking oral medications for 24 hours and ambulatory at the time of discharge. Stable New York Heart Association Class IV patients will be eligible for randomization.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No NYHA class or CHF status specified.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The presence of any of the following unequivocal cardiac sources of embolism: chronic or paroxysmal AF, mechanical valve, endocarditis, intracardiac mobile or pedunculated thrombus, and valvular vegetation.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of AF, mechanical valve, or other embolic sources.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Cyanotic congenital heart disease, Eisenmenger's syndrome.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of decompensated heart failure.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Cardiac surgery, angioplasty, or MI within the past 3 months prior to randomization.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient had CABG and PTCA but no data on timing relative to randomization.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: A contraindication to the use of either warfarin or aspirin, e.g. active peptic ulcer disease, active bleeding diathesis, platelets <100,000*, hematocrit <30, INR >1.3 (if not on warfarin), clotting factor abnormality that increases the risk of bleeding, alcohol or substance abuse, severe gait instability, cerebral hemorrhage, systemic hemorrhage within the past year, severe liver impairment (AST >3x normal*, cirrhosis), any condition requiring regular use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agents, allergy to aspirin or warfarin, uncontrolled severe hypertension (systolic pressure >180 mm Hg or diastolic pressure > 110 mm Hg), positive stool guaiac not attributable to hemorrhoids, creatinine >3.0*.
Patient needs continuing therapy with intravenous heparin or low molecular weight heparin or a specific antiplatelet agent.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of requiring IV anticoagulation.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Dementia or psychiatric or physical problem that prevents the patient from following an outpatient program reliably.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of dementia or psychiatric issues.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Comorbid conditions that may limit survival to less than five years.

Pregnancy, or female of childbearing potential who is not sterilized or is not using a medically accepted form of contraception* (see procedure manual). *A pregnancy test is required for all women of childbearing age.
Enrollment in another study that would conflict with WARCEF.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of enrollment in other studies.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Hospitalization for new diagnosis of onset CHF within the past one month or carotid endarterectomy or pacemaker insertion within the past one month prior to randomization.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No data on recent hospitalizations or procedures.

Recap: Unclear eligibility due to missing data on left ventricular function, Modified Rankin score, ACE inhibitor use, and NYHA class. No exclusion criteria violations identified.
